commits.subject: refactor: split seed_objlit_aliases out of safe_binding_chain (rotation-362 close audit - the dup-group wiring pushed the fn to 215 lines past the 200 hard limit; the knife-4c objlit-field + var-hoisted alias seeding moves verbatim to a free fn returning the assign_legal whitelist, safe_binding_chain back to 163)

fix: any ?? T joins to any instead of unboxing the lhs to rhs width (a non-nullish any lhs is the result per 13.4.2 whatever its tag holds, but check_nullish answered rhs_ty so the lowering's unbox_lhs_to_rhs_ty read an f64 box's raw bits as an i64 - argsAnyArr[0] ?? nParam printed 4611686018427387904 - and squeezed non-bool payloads through a != 0 test so any(0) ?? true answered false; the checker now answers any and lower_any_lhs boxes the rhs side expr-aware under the chunk-722 transfer contract, mirroring the ternary widen posture; surfaced by the rest-param probe family riding apply_rest_args packing)

feat: dup-named binding groups admit per-scope into the argc/argv tiers (l3b follow-up - two fns each declaring const f = function(){...arguments...} is the test262 helper idiom the rotation-362 nested tier conservatively dropped; admit_dup_groups re-runs the kill walk per instance against its owner fndecl's body_owned_exprs mask, requiring distinct top-level owners, seeded closure inits, zero stray uses outside every mask, and a solo-chain legal-use pass per instance with no alias growth; all-or-nothing per group keeps the name-keyed locals set unambiguous; safe_binding_chain returns pairs since a dup group maps one name to several fns; admit fn split to arguments_object_chain/dup.rs under the 500-line rule)

feat: fn-nested closures join the arguments argc/argv value tiers (l3b nested face - the shared safe_binding_chain seeded only top-level letdecls, which was the single thing keeping fn-nested const f = function(){...arguments...} loud since the lifted closure is already a top-level fndecl the tier collectors see; the direct seed, alias-grow fixpoint and the kill walk's alias-init exemption now walk all nested statement containers, and a name bound more than once anywhere is conservatively dropped because the by-name kill walk cannot split scopes)

feat: ternary (typed : null) joins go through any (l3b-6 - nullable-scalar had no ssa repr: the f64 lane refused constptrnull loudly while the i64/bool lanes stored its zero bits silently (7:null printed 0) and a nullable-struct join read constptrnull as a live layout (unknown-any-tag); unify_ternary joins null against number/boolean/struct to any mirroring the undefined arm, and the ternary widen boxes both sides expr-aware so the null side folds to any_null; ptr-repr branches keep their nullable join)

feat: container-stored fn-exprs join the arguments argv face (l3b - array-literal element positions are boxed-only consumption so the binding-chain kill walk admits them alongside the escape-store/arg-position profiles; a rest-tail closure value callee like box[0](...) routes through the boxed dual entry via emit_variadic_boxed_call mirroring the struct-field variadic arm, instead of the declared-sig env-first callindirect that fed the injected argv params garbage; safe_binding_chain + collect_legal_uses split to arguments_object_chain sibling under the 500-line rule)

docs: rotation 361 close - l3b parallel-face four-clear (closure/fndecl typed+fnsig defaults via typednarrow lane, generic fn value escape via anywv clone), ternary widen orphaned-block fix, sweep +1 conserved zero regressions, dashboard refresh

feat: implicit-generic fn values escape through an all-any clone (l3b-3 - a let-bound generic fn's typevar face rejected every callindirect argument; the let-decl check widens the binding face and records the site, check_monomorph_any_widen drains it through a parameterized emit_widened_spec into a $$anywv spec, and the ident lowering takes the clone's address via the existing call_retargets channel)

feat: fn-shaped defaults capturing a prior param evaluate in the callee (l3b-4 fn-sig shape - typednarrow ann gate admits fn-shaped anns riding the any-to-closure let narrow, body_safe_default relaxes the arrow arm from closed-only to free-vars-within-prior-params, refs_prior_param reads an arrow's capture set; unannotated params with the same capturing default ride the relaxation on the any lane)

feat: fndecl scalar-typed defaults that read a prior param evaluate in the callee (l3b-4 scalar shape - typednarrow lane extends to fndecls gated on refs_prior_param, so the pad no longer pastes the expression into the caller's scope; guard/pad construction shared between the fndecl and arrowfn walks; plain typed literal defaults keep the pad channel untouched)

fix: ternary widen tracks blocks the box lanes open (widen_branches ends are now in-out - box_f64_or_undef splits into undef/num/merge for a possibly-sentinel f64, and the join's store/br used to land on the stale branch end, overwriting the box's condbr and orphaning its merge block: regalloc valueid-not-allocated, sigsegv with egraph off; latent for every 'cond ? typedArr[i] : undefined' join since the oob-read rfc, exposed by the l3b-1 typednarrow lane feeding undefined defaults into the spread ternary expansion)

feat: closure scalar-typed defaults fire on runtime undefined (l3b-1 route a - arrowfn typednarrow lane renames the param to a __dflt any carrier, body-head guard + let narrow back to the declared scalar; plus the pre-existing any-to-boolean let-narrow hole - bool row was missing from the binding-boundary kind table so a false box read as true)
